dish: Kushikatsu (beef, shrimp, sasami-shōga) with the shared no-double-dip sauce
address: Jan Jan Yokochō (Nan'yō-dōri), Ebisuhigashi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka
w: Jan Jan Yokochō's long-queue kushikatsu counter (founded post-war, 1940s), profiled by Inside Osaka and singled out by Nippon.com as the Shinsekai shop with the longest lines.

dish: Horumon & yakiniku — every part of the cow over charcoal
address: In front of Tsuruhashi Station, Osaka
w: Tsuruhashi's busiest Korean-style yakiniku/horumon house, Time Out's pick for the district and Inside Osaka's 'perpetually busy' recommendation — reserve.

dish: Purin (custard pudding) & cream soda, kissaten coffee
w: Retro Shinsekai kissaten serving pitch-black coffee, custard pudding and cream soda beneath Tsūtenkaku since 1967 (Time Out); Rurubu flags its 'Purin Royale'.
